newsitem.title: JAPAN: JAL shares drop to year low in morning.
newsitem.headline: JAL shares drop to year low in morning.

text.p: Shares in Japan Airlines Co Ltd (JAL) dropped on Wednesday morning to their lowest price so far this year.
The share price fell to as low as 640 yen, below its previous low of 650 yen set on October 31. As of 0029 GMT, it was trading nine yen lower at 643 yen, on volume of 467,000 shares.
"The air transport sector is overall bearish. It seems like investors are selling issues which are not backed by good earnings outlooks," said a trader at a second-tier Japanese securities house.
Shares in All Nippon Airways Co Ltd also dropped to their lowest level for this year on Wednesday, briefly hitting 935 yen before recovering slightly to 937 yen at midday.
